This is because you're using multiple hooks in a single component. That's an edge case that will be covered by https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6660 and the `skipSuspense` option so that a second widget will be discoverable in the server.

solutions are thus:
1. wait until the option is released
2. patch InstantSearch yourself to include the code of #6660 
3. use only one hook per component

The underlying reason for this happening is that we suspend at the first hook already, meaning the second widget in the same component won't be discovered.

Yes, it will be merged soon, we're just working on the documentation of the new parameters and guides

Looks like this was merged, and in the reproduction repo it seems fixed.

However, in our production one, we intermittently get results from the server, sometimes being zero and sometimes having search results.

> Due to the way the App Router and <InstantSearchNext> are implemented, you can’t compose hooks the same way as you would normally do in React InstantSearch. All React InstantSearch hooks have a skipSuspense option that you can set to true to skip the suspense behavior. This should be done to all hooks but the last one in your custom component.

Also, is this for each custom component? Or does it apply across components? I have many custom components that rely on hooks

Every custom component that has multiple hooks in it needs to pass that option: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/server-side-rendering/react/#composing-hooks

I'll close this issue now, but if you can reproduce in a different repo, open a new issue please as that would be another cause then.
